_schema.description: Polls entered by hand, in polls.json's shape (see its _schema), for polls Wikipedia hasn't listed yet. refresh.py (merge_manual_polls) adds each one to polls.json until Wikipedia has a poll from the same pollster ending within two days of it; from then on Wikipedia's figures win and this entry only fills fields Wikipedia's row lacks (e.g. a second preferred-premier measure). Remove an entry once Wikipedia carries everything in it. 'via' names where the figures were taken from.

fields.polls: [poll objects: id, start_date, end_date, pollster, client, sample_size, source_url, primary, tpp, preferred_premier, preferred_premier_alt, approval, via {label, url}, added]

via.label: The Poll Bludger, 9 Nov 2026 (reporting the Herald Sun)
